title: 12-Layer QW-Seeded Stack with Expanded Bounds
scientific_hypothesis: The 12-layer configuration achieved peak performance (0.7448) because it provides sufficient degrees of freedom for dual-band spectral shaping without excessive local minima. Resetting initialization to quarter-wave optical thickness at 1350 nm with ±25% bounds will recover and potentially exceed prior best performance by anchoring the optimizer near a physically meaningful starting point.
design_principle: Quarter-wave optical thickness initialization at central SWIR wavelength (1350 nm) provides constructive interference baseline for transmission band while allowing optimization to develop UV reflection stopband through thickness deviations.
proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate (12 finite layers, alternating HfO2-first)
design_variables: layer_thicknesses_nm (12 variables, bounded ±25% from QW medians)
soft_objectives: maintain smooth spectral transition between bands
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds [130-217] nm for HfO2, [175-291] nm for SiO2 based on ±25% of QW at 1350 nm
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for plane-wave propagation through isotropic layered media
Quarter-wave stack theory for constructive/destructive interference positioning
expected_advantages: Returns to best-performing layer count from prior iterations
QW initialization reduces optimizer search space and avoids poor local minima
Expanded bounds restore optical path tuning capacity per feedback directive
known_risks: May converge to same local optimum as round 2 if bounds too restrictive
12 layers may limit UV reflection bandwidth compared to higher layer counts
execution_request_english: Optimize a 12-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2 (12 finite layers total). Initialize thicknesses at quarter-wave optical thickness at 1350 nm reference wavelength: HfO2 = 173 nm, SiO2 = 233 nm. Apply thickness bounds: HfO2 [130, 217] nm, SiO2 [175, 291] nm (±25% of QW medians). Optimize all 12 layer thicknesses using gradient-based optimizer. Spectral evaluation: 300-450 nm (target high reflectance), 1000-1700 nm (target high transmittance). Normal incidence, unpolarized illumination. Maximize weighted spectral performance across both bands. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1000-1700 nm; transmission in 300-450 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count <= 30.
revision_reason: Returns to 12L count (best prior performance 0.7448) with expanded ±25% bounds and QW-seeded initialization per feedback directive to restore optical path tuning capacity and anchor optimizer near physically meaningful starting point.
